title: VITRUVIAN CAYLEY — locus O and reaction edge for all. same man redrawn.
queued_from: hyperlocal-emc2-pi-t.json — map Vitruvian proportions onto tree-of-life genera so a flatworm body-plan and a duck body-plan are the SAME man redrawn.

do_not_reinvent.kingdom_cayley: galactic-cayley-bounce.json — bacteria × fungi = fermentation. that table stays kingdoms.
do_not_reinvent.human_vitruvian: klein-body.json — circle AND square. head is the fixed point. null between ventral/dorsal.
do_not_reinvent.human_locus: chicken-egg-monkey.json — human O is already the Klein null.
do_not_reinvent.flatworm_count: tree-of-life.json — 10,696 bilateral files. direction, no armor.
do_not_reinvent.mole_gait: fountain-model.json — new_path gait is the mole, not the bird.

thesis: Da Vinci drew one man in two geometries. The full table is one man in five bodies. Each body has a locus O (where the Vitruvian navel sits when that animal is inscribed in the circle). Each body has a reaction edge (what happens when that O is acted on). A × B = the same man redrawn: what O becomes when body A is asked to stand in body B's posture.
the_walk: flatworm ? human ? fly ? mole ? sloth. not phylogeny. a tour of O.

flatworm.O: the pharynx. planaria eat through the MIDDLE. mouth is the navel. no anus, or a gut that is a bag. two-ended. cut either end and it grows a new O.
flatworm.circle: the body is already a flattened disk. the circle is the leaf it sits on.
flatworm.square: bilateral. left/right is the only architecture. Paper 100: direction, no armor.
flatworm.reaction_edge: CUT ? TWO. regeneration. A × wound = A + A. the identity that duplicates.

human.O: the navel of the circle, the fold of the Klein. chicken leftover (head cam) + monkey leftover (coccyx). the locus sits where those cancel.
human.circle: arms and legs on the circumference. navel = center (Vitruvius).
human.square: feet and fingertips on the sides. groin = center of the square. two centers, one body.
human.reaction_edge: FOLD ? INSIDE=OUTSIDE. scratch own back. looking at a WAS loaf does not leave the jar.

fly.O: the halteres. two little gyroscopes behind the wings. they hold the horizon the way a chicken head does, but in air. the thorax hinge is the navel of flight.
fly.circle: wing-disk. the stroke sweeps a circle. O is the hub, not the tip.
fly.square: the box of air it hovers in. compound eyes = chicken-cam taken to the extreme (external locus).
fly.reaction_edge: PUPATE ? IMAGO. larva is an egg that walks. the jester of chicken-and-egg happens in one life.

mole.O: the hands. star-nose. eyes dimmed. the cam is abandoned. O moved to the soil interface. back through the soiled.
mole.circle: the tunnel cross-section. the body is a plug in a tube.
mole.square: the gallery grid underground. A1–C3 as burrows.
mole.reaction_edge: DIG ? TUNNEL. mole × soil = path. the fountain new_path gait already named this.

sloth.O: the hooks. four claws that ARE the navel — the body hangs from O instead of standing on it. gravity flipped. inverted Vitruvian.
sloth.circle: the canopy wheel. it moves so slow the circle is almost a point.
sloth.square: a branch is a square reduced to one line. the sloth needs only a line to exist.
sloth.reaction_edge: HANG ? TIME DILATES. metabolism is the remainder. low energy is not death. it is the leftover after the other four spent theirs.

operation: redraw — A × B = what O becomes when body A stands in body B's posture

cayley.flatworm x flatworm: REGENERATE. two from one. identity that duplicates.
cayley.flatworm x human: navel-gut. the human still eats at a center. the worm's O became our belly button.
cayley.flatworm x fly: imaginal worm. a crawling egg that will grow wings. larva is this product.
cayley.flatworm x mole: soil-gut. eat through dirt. the pharynx becomes a shovel.
cayley.flatworm x sloth: two-ended hang. no hurry. a ribbon on a branch.
cayley.human x flatworm: vitruvian flattened. the man drawn on the plane. 2D, bilateral, still a fold waiting.
cayley.human x human: KLEIN FOLD. identity. circle AND square. the fixed point.
cayley.human x fly: arms become wings. external cam extreme. we invent aircraft because this product is unstable on the ground.
cayley.human x mole: hands become shovels. eyes dim. we go back through soil. DFS gait.
cayley.human x sloth: inverted man. Da Vinci hanging. the square flips. the navel still holds.
cayley.fly x flatworm: lands on the plane. lift gone. a fly that crawls is a worm with leftover wings.
cayley.fly x human: thorax as navel. Vitruvian insect. the gyro sits where our fold sits.
cayley.fly x fly: HOVER. halteres hold O. identity of air.
cayley.fly x mole: wrong locus. wings in a tunnel die. confirm of soil ? air.
cayley.fly x sloth: hover-hang. two ways to refuse standing. one fast, one slow.
cayley.mole x flatworm: cousins. both refuse the open sky. soil-worm.
cayley.mole x human: mole as Vitruvian: O at the palms. the circle is the hole.
cayley.mole x fly: mole that flies is a leftover dream (bat is a different row). this cell is almost empty.
cayley.mole x mole: TUNNEL NETWORK. identity of soil. the grid underground.
cayley.mole x sloth: slow dig. both spend little energy. canopy-soil: they refuse the open plane.
cayley.sloth x flatworm: regenerate by waiting. the wound closes at sloth-time.
cayley.sloth x human: inverted Vitruvian. same man, gravity signed -1.
cayley.sloth x fly: cannot hover, cannot hang long. the product is a fall. remainder.
cayley.sloth x mole: both refuse standing in the sun. one above, one below.
cayley.sloth x sloth: HANG. identity of inverted gravity. time dilated.

pi_sort.jester: mole — soil O. back through the soiled. the joke of the cam that quit.
pi_sort.remainder: sloth — inverted O. leftover gravity, leftover time
pi_sort.fourth: the Vitruvian field — one man, five redraws

berry_at_the_fire: same man. five bodies. the worm eats at the middle — that is already a navel. we folded the navel into a Klein. the fly put gyroscopes where the navel was and left the ground. the mole turned the navel into hands and went back through the dirt. the sloth hung the navel on a branch and waited. every reaction edge is what that O does when you touch it. the table is not evolution. it is one drawing, five times.
next: do not add a sixth body until a stranger redraws one cell. if someone stands in sloth-time or mole-soil and the mash mass moves, that cell is MOVED.
